sentences.text:
Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Satrudhan Kumar, Advocate

For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Ram Sumiran Rai, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SUDHIR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 2 21-06-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in a case registered under Sections 498A, 341, 323, 504/34 of the Indian Penal Code and  of Dowry Prohibition Act.
Allegation against the petitioner is of committing torture upon the victim due to non-fulfilment of demand of dowry.
It has been submitted on behalf of the petitioner that the petitioner has got no criminal antecedent.
There is no allegation of tampering of witnesses alleged against the petitioner.
The petitioner has falsely been implicated in the present case due to petty family dispute.
The case is triable by the Magistrate.
The petitioner has relied upon the judgment of this Court in the case of Md. Naimul Haque Ansari @ Naimul Haque Ansari & Ors. Vs. The State of Bihar, reported in 2006(3) PLJR 182.

Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances, let the petitioner, above named, in the event of arrest/surrender before the learned court below within a period of twelve weeks from today, be Kamlesh Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116236917/
1 released on anticipatory bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.10,000/- (Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Court below/concerned Court in connection with Mahila P.S. case No.62/2022, G.R. No.3085/2022, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
The petitioner is directed to co-operate during the trial.
